sections.description_of_ingredients:

 Shuddha Gandhak – Purified form of Sulphur is used as a medicine in Ayurveda. It purifies blood and also stabilizes the endocrine function. It maintains the proper circulation to the genitals. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Prepare kajjali from Shuddha Parada and Shuddha Gandhak. 
 Give 3 bhavna with kamal phool (Lotus Flower) and also properly mix it for 3 days.

Kaminimadbhanjan Rasa 
 Reference – Bhaishajya-Ratnavali Vajikaranadhikar 1131/64-65 
 Introduction 
 Kaminimadbhanjan rasa is an Ayurvedic medicine and used as Aphrodisiac. It increases the sperm count and is used in various sexual problems. It functions same as Viagra. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada (Purified Mercury) – 1 part 
 Shuddha Gandhak (Purified Sulphur) – 1 part 
 
 Description of Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada – It is used in Ayurvedic medicines after purification. It is used in proper functioning of the hormones as it acts as a Rasayan. It also works on improving Digestion. 
 Shuddha Gandhak – Purified form of Sulphur is used as a medicine in Ayurveda. It purifies blood and also stabilizes the endocrine function. It maintains the proper circulation to the genitals. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Prepare kajjali from Shuddha Parada and Shuddha Gandhak. 
 Give 3 bhavna with kamal phool (Lotus Flower) and also properly mix it for 3 days. 
 After drying, keep this kajjali into an airtight container which is covered with soil and heat this mixture over the flames for 9 hours in a Baluka yantra. 
 On the next day take out this mixture and give bhavna with kesar ( Crocus sativus ) mixed water for the next two days. 
 After drying kept this formulation in a glass container. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Kaminimadbhanjan rasa is an old medicine which is used as an aphrodisiac. The ingredients in this formulation help in improving reproductive functions. They provide proper nutrition to the tissues of the genitals. They stabilize the endocrine system which ultimately improves the hormonal imbalance. 
 Indications

 Low sperm count

 Dosage 
 125 mg with honey or ghee. 
 Cautions

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
